description: Change a version: its name, description, days, or whether it is archived. Only what you pass is changed. A version is what a project's work goes out in — '2.4.0', 'Autumn'. It is the project's own: an issue carries versions of its own project only, any number of them ('fixVersions' on create_issue, update_issue and get_issue; JQL 'fixVersion = "2.4.0"', 'fixVersion in unreleasedVersions()'). An issue that carries the version goes on carrying it under a new name. Archiving puts it away — still on its issues, no longer offered for new ones — and is undone the same way. Releasing is release_version's, not this tool's. Answers with the version as list_versions gives it. Project lead or admin only.

archived.description: true puts it away; false brings it back.

description.description: A new description. An empty string removes it.

releaseDate.description: The day it is meant to ship, as YYYY-MM-DD. An empty string clears it.

startDate.description: The day work on it starts, as YYYY-MM-DD. An empty string clears it.

version.description: The version, by its name or its id from list_versions.

name: update_version
